technique_name: Cé Ti Bảo Jiáo Zhi Li (Side kick up to catch the foot at head level with the leg held vertically while remaining standing)

questions.question: What is the error code for Cé Ti Bảo Jiáo Zhi Li (Side kick up to catch the foot at head level)?
What are the two main deduction points for Cé Ti Bảo Jiáo Zhi Li?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Supporting leg is bent, and 2) Raised leg is bent.
choices: A deduction is applied when the sweeping leg is bent 45° or more.
Deductions are applied when: 1) Supporting leg is bent, and 2) Raised leg is bent.
A deduction is applied when the kicking leg does not transit from obvious bent (45° or more) to completely straight.
Because one leg is crossed in front of the supporting leg while maintaining balance on the supporting leg.

questions.question: How should both legs be positioned in a correct Cé Ti Bảo Jiáo Zhi Li balance technique?
questions.answer: Both the supporting leg and the raised leg should be completely straight, with no bending at the knees.
choices: Both the supporting leg and the raised leg should be completely straight, with no bending at the knees.
A deduction is applied when the raised leg is held below horizontal level.
The raised foot's toes should be pointed and hooking inwards.
